articles.summary: Net sales were $1,036.8 million, including a $355.7 million contribution from American Woodmark Net loss was $(9.2) million and net loss margin was (0.9)% Adjusted EBITDA 1 was $86.0 million, representing an adjusted EBITDA margin 1 of 8.3% Diluted loss per share was $(0.05) and adjusted diluted earnings per share 1 was $0.10 Integration of American Woodmark ahead of schedule, with $11 million of cost synergies realized to-date MasterBrand, Inc. (NYSE: MBC, the “Company,” or “MasterBrand”), the largest residential cabinet manufacturer in North America, today announced third quarter 2026 financial results. “Our first full quarter as a combined company showed real momentum on integration, with synergies ahead of schedule,” said Dave Banyard, President and Chief Executive Officer. “We are realizing the benefits of our combined scale and managing through ongoing market softness with operating discipline, and legacy MasterBrand gained share across our end markets despite ongoing demand
articles.title: MasterBrand Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
